_comment: XP and levels. xp_needed = XP to go from this level to the next (last level: none). Leftover XP carries over. Proposed numbers; the board judges them in playtests. T-328 (Game loop architecture, Decisions, 'More gift packs, earlier'): the early levels need far fewer likes (30, 45, 65, 95 for levels 2 to 5, was 100, 125, 156, 195), the last two are unchanged; total 3,501 for all 11 level-ups, was 4,255. challenge_xp (old MVP map only) keeps its share of the level's bar, capped at the old value, so one challenge still never skips a level the way it did not before.

car._comment: Hearts (Game loop architecture, Decisions, 'Hearts instead of health points', 2026-10-28; T-333). starting_hearts replaces starting_health (100). After any hit the car is invulnerable for invulnerability_seconds (1 s, the board's number), blinking: blink_interval_seconds is how long each on or off phase of the blink lasts (0.1 s, 5 full blinks in the second; a proposal for the playtest, T-334 builds the behaviour). The old contact repeat (a hit every 0.5 s while touching) is gone: the invulnerability is what spaces the hits.

pickup_magnet._comment: Pickup magnet (Game loop architecture, Decisions, 2026-10-21): coins, landed gift packs and health drops within radius_units of the car's centre are pulled towards it at pull_speed_units_per_second. radius_units 3.0 is 1 car length (the car is drawn 3 units long, Drifting, Decisions); the garage upgrade (T-224) sets RunState.pickup_magnet_radius_units from it. The pull speed is a proposal: faster than the car's top speed (27.5), so a pickup always catches the car.

likes_drain._comment: Likes drain (Game loop architecture, Decisions, 2026-10-13): once the combo has fully drained, the likes bar empties, never below the start of the current level. A share of the current level's bar per second, not a flat XP amount, so a full bar always takes the same time to empty at every level; a flat amount would be harsh at level 1 and meaningless at level 11 (931 XP). bar_share_per_second 0.08 is the board's playtest value (2026-10-13, four times the first proposal of 0.02): a full bar empties in 1 / 0.08 = 12.5 s, 8 likes a second at level 1, and the drain only ever eats progress made inside the current level. extra_wait_seconds is an optional pause after the combo has drained before the drain starts; 0 follows the board's rule (the combo's own 2 s wait and drain already give a buffer).

wreck._comment: Wrecked (Game loop architecture, Decisions, 'Wrecked: the stream keeps rolling', board, 2026-10-29; T-360): when the last heart is gone the controls go dead and the car smokes and burns for seconds (3 s, the board's number) before the run ends. The smoke and flame numbers are the placeholder look drawn in code (scripts/run/wreck_effect.gd), proposals for the playtest; T-361's pixel art animations replace the drawing. Pixel sizes are screen pixels at zoom 1.

hit_flash._comment: Red hit flash (Game loop architecture, Decisions, 'A red flash when the car takes damage', board, 2026-10-30; T-403, scripts/run/hit_flash.gd, reused for enemies by T-404). Proposals for the playtest. seconds: how long the flash lasts after a hit that counts. 0.4 s covers the first two visible phases of the 0.1 s invulnerability blink (the car is hidden 0 to 0.1, red 0.1 to 0.2, hidden, red 0.3 to 0.4), then the plain blink goes on. color: the multiply tint [r, g, b].

time_up._comment: Time's up (Game loop architecture, Decisions, 'Time's up screen', board, 2026-10-28; T-317): when the 8-minute timer runs out with the kaiju alive, the run is lost and frozen at 0:00 while the time's up screen plays for seconds (3 s, the board's number), then the run ends. 0 ends the run at once, as before T-317.
